title: Getting started
intro: How to sign in and find your way around Company Portal.

steps: Open **portal.example.com** in your browser.
Type your **User ID** (your Staff Code) and **password**, then press **Sign in**.
After signing in you always start on **General › Dashboard**. A link to a page (e.g. from an email) still opens that page.
First time: you must set a new password - at least **10 characters with letters and numbers**.
Capital or small letters in the User ID do not matter (LKH002 = lkh002).
Forgot your password? Ask the **Super Admin** to reset it.
The **🌐** button at the top (next to the bell) chooses **English**, **Bahasa Melayu** or **中文** (Chinese). Your choice is remembered in this browser.
Only the screen text is translated - names, positions, outlets, memo text and anything typed stay as they are.
The menu on the left is grouped by department: **General**, **Purchase Dept**, **Marketing Dept**, **HR Dept**.
Click a department to open or close it. You only see the programs you have access to.
On a phone, tap **☰** (top left) to show the menu.
This **User Manual** is at the bottom of the side menu - everyone can open it.
**Change password** - set a new password any time.
**✍ My signature** - draw or upload your signature once; it is used when you approve a memo.
**Sign out** - when you leave the computer.
Click the **Company logo** (top left) to go back to **General › Dashboard** from any page.

**Install as an app** (phone or computer): open **https://portal.example.com**, then on Android / Chrome press **⋮ › Install app** (or your name menu › **📲 Install as app**); on iPhone / iPad press **Share › Add to Home Screen**. You get a **Company Portal** icon that opens full screen - same screens as the website.
**🔔 Bell** (top right): COA expiry alerts, Email Batch notices, MC reminders and memos waiting for you - click it to see them.
You are **signed out automatically** after a while without activity - just sign in again.
When the portal is updated, a box shows **"A new version of the portal is ready"** - press **Reload**.
Fields with a red **\*** must be filled in.

title: General Dashboard
intro: General › Dashboard › General Dashboard - everything new for you on one page.

steps: **Counters** at the top - click one to go to its page.
**📢 New Memo** - your newest memos; **NEW** until you open them.
**🆕 New System Update** - what changed in each version of the portal.
**✅ Action needed** - only shows when you have something to do: approvals, forms or sections still to submit, batches not sent, MC or transfer steps. Click an item to open it.
**📄 My Document Status** - every document **you** submitted and where it is now. Filter by module or search; **Show all** for older ones.
Memos are shown by year. **▦** shows cards, **☰** shows the memos one below the other.
A red **NEW** means you have not opened it yet.
Click a card to read the memo; **🖨 Print** prints it (a PDF memo opens - print it from there).
If the memo is in more than one language, the buttons above it (**English / Bahasa Melayu / 中文**) switch the language; you first see your own language. **✎** marks the main language.
HR chooses who can view each memo: **All**, or a State / Outlet and / or Department / Position.
Your outlet and position come from **Staff Master Data** - if they are wrong, tell HR.

title: Memo - creating and posting (HR)
intro: For HR: General › Memo › View Memo (+) or Memo Listings (New).

steps: Press **+** (View Memo) or **New** (Memo Listings), then choose **Upload** (a PDF) or **Manual Create** (type it in, or **📄 Import Word**).
Fill in **Title**, **Person in Charge** (who approves), the **PDF** or the **Content**.

**Who can view**: tick **All**, or tick States (then only their outlets show - tick outlets to narrow) and / or Departments (then only their positions show). If you tick both a place and a department, staff must match both.

**🌐 Other languages** (optional): choose **Written in** (the main language), then type the title and text in **Bahasa Melayu** and **中文** in the boxes below. The toolbar works on the box you clicked last. Staff read the memo in their own language; an empty language shows the main one.
Check the **👁 Preview** under the form: the memo as it will look and **how many staff it reaches**.
Press **Save** - the memo is **Processing** (waiting for the person in charge).
When the person in charge has approved it, the memo is **Approved** (you also see it under Action needed).
Open the memo, check it and press **📢 Post** - the chosen staff can now see it.
**Edit** is possible while Processing or Approved (an edit after approval needs a new approval). **Cancel** is possible any time.
Every memo with its status: Processing, Approved, Posted, Cancelled.
Search in the boxes under the headings; the **⋮** menu has View, Edit, Post, Print and Cancel.

title: Memo - approving (person in charge)
intro: General › Memo › Memo Approval - memos waiting for your approval.

steps: Open the memo from **Memo Approval** (or from **Action needed** on the dashboard) and read it.
Press **✔ Approve** and choose your signature: **saved signature**, **draw** it, or **upload** a picture. Tick **Save this signature** to use it next time.
Your signature, name, User ID and date are added to the memo (for a PDF: bottom right of the last page). HR then posts it.

**Approve in AppSheet** (if your company uses the AppSheet app): open **Memo Approval**, read the memo and choose **Decision = Approve**. The system approves it at the next sync (a few minutes) with your **saved signature** - so save one first (name menu › ✍ My signature). Your email in the system must be the same Google account you use in AppSheet. The **Result** column shows what happened.
The Dashboard lists the applications with their status, COA No. and how many sections are submitted.
Use the search box and the status filter; **Export list (CSV)** downloads the list.
**+ New Application** starts a new one (if your account may create).
Open an application and fill in the sections you have access to (A to I). Your work is saved as you go.
When a section is complete press **Submit** (if your account may submit - otherwise an Admin submits).
Section I has **ST** and **eCOS** tabs (Section B "ST / eCOS" decides which are shown) with fees, status, COA No. and expiry.
The bell and the dashboard warn you **1 month before a COA expires**.
The warning stops when a **Renewal** application with that COA No. as Previous COA No. is created.
The Dashboard lists the consignment test forms; **+ New Application** starts one (if your account may create).
Open a form, fill it in and **Submit** when complete.
Forms still to submit show under **Action needed** on the General Dashboard.

A Draft made by mistake (never submitted): the **Super Admin** can press **🗑 Delete** on the form and type the form number to remove it completely (form, files and history). A submitted form can only be cancelled.

title: Email Batch
intro: Marketing Dept › Email Batch › Batches - one personal email to each customer.

steps: Press **+ New Batch** and give it a title.

**1. Template**: write the subject and email text. **[Field Name]** is replaced by each customer's own value (click a field chip to add it). **📄 Import Word template** takes a Word file with its formatting.
**2. Customers**: **📥 Import customers** from Excel, CSV or Word, or **+ Add customer**. Each field becomes a column.
Check the list (search, Ready / Not ready); **✉ Send test to me** shows how it looks; then press **📤 Send to … customers**.
Emails go out one by one. If the daily limit is reached, the batch **waits** and continues the next day.

If the mail server refuses emails the batch **stops** - you get a notice (bell and email). Check the error, then press **📤 Continue sending**; **↻ Send the failed ones again** retries the failed ones.
A copy of every email sent is kept in the batch.

title: Staff Master Data
intro: HR Dept › Staff Master Data › Staff List.

steps: Search, filter by status, BR (outlet) and position; click a heading to sort.
**+ Add staff**, **📥 Import Excel** (BR, Staff Code, Staff Name, IC No., Position, Email, Joined / Resigned Date) and **⬇ Export Excel**.
**✨ Select newcomers** ticks the staff without a login (it follows the filters).
**Create logins** makes their accounts: User ID = Staff Code, first password **DAR.0166** - they must change it at the first sign-in.
If HR gave you a **Coverage Branch**, you see **HR Dept › Staff Master Data › Staff List** with only the staff of those branches.
The blue box at the top shows **Your coverage**.
You can **+ Add staff** and **✎ Edit** staff of your branches. A staff cannot be moved out of your branches - ask HR.
Import, Update selected, Remove and the coverage itself are done by HR.
Open the staff (e.g. an Operation Manager or Branch / Area Manager) with **✎ Edit**.
Open **🗺 Coverage Branch - for managers**, tick the outlets (search by outlet or state, **Tick shown**), then **Save**.
The person then sees and manages the staff of those branches. Clear the ticks to take it away.
Excel import also takes the column **Coverage Branch** (e.g. "KL01, PG02").
**✚ MC Request Form**: fill in the details and attach the MC picture, then **Submit** - status **Submitted**.
Submit the MC **within 48 hours**: Date Apply can be backdated at most 48 hours and not set in the future. For an older MC, ask HR (HR is not limited; HR sets the hours in **Settings › HR Setting**).
Until HR opens it you can still change it: open the request and press **✎ Edit** (Leave Number, Date Apply) or add / remove MC pictures. Once it is **Processing** it can no longer be changed.
When HR opens it, it becomes **Processing** (locked); then **Approved** or **Rejected**.
Bring the **original MC** to HR within the lead time (normally **30 days**). You are reminded when 10 days are left. If it does not reach HR in time, the request is **rejected automatically**.
When HR receives the original, the request is **Completed**.

Who sees what (HR Dept): you see the documents you made, every document with **your own Staff Code** on it, and - if you are a manager with a Coverage Branch - the documents of the staff under you in the structure. Only the maker (or HR) can change a document.
If HR gave you a **Coverage Branch**, you can also submit the MC of **the staff under you in the structure** (positions below yours, in your branches).
On the **MC Request Form**, click **Staff Code** and type a code or name - you are first in the list, then your team.

The **MC Request List** also shows the requests of the staff under you (also the ones they submitted themselves) - you can view them; only the person who submitted a request can change it. HR approves or rejects them as usual.
**MC Request List** shows every request; open one to **Approve** or **Reject**, and tick **original MC received** when it arrives.
Lead time and reminder days are set in **Settings › HR Setting**.
**Document Type** choices (MC, OMC, ...) are set by HR in **Settings › HR Setting › MC Request** - code and name; the code starts the Document Number (e.g. MC-2610-001).

title: Transfer Form
intro: HR Dept › Transfer › Transfer Form / Transfer List.

steps: Choose **Permanent** (one staff) or **Temporary** (one or more staff).
Type the **Staff ID** - name, IC No. and outlet fill in from Staff Master Data; the working hours fill in from the "To" outlet.
No backdating: the Effective From Date (Permanent) and From Date (Temporary) must be **today or later**. HR is not limited.
**Save** - status **Drafted**. Print the letter, get it signed, then **upload the signed letter** with the signers' Name, ID No. (User ID) and date - status **Submitted**.
Until HR opens it you can still **✎ Edit** the form or upload a new signed letter. When HR opens it, it becomes **Processing** and can no longer be changed.

Who sees what (HR Dept): you see the documents you made, every document with **your own Staff Code** on it, and - if you are a manager with a Coverage Branch - the documents of the staff under you in the structure. Only the maker (or HR) can change a document.
HR prints, signs and uploads its letter - your form becomes **Completed**.
Open the completed form - it becomes **Checked**.

**Transfer List** shows every form. Forms in **Submitted** wait for HR: open one (it becomes **Processing**), print the letter, sign it and upload HR's signed letter with Name, ID No. (User ID), date and remarks - status **Completed**.
When the outlet opens the completed form it becomes **Checked**.
HR can **Cancel** a form (not after Checked).

title: Time Adjustment
intro: HR Dept › Time Adjustment › Time Adjustment Form / Time Adjustment Listing - correct the clock-in / out times of staff in SBClient.

steps: **✚ Time Adjustment Form**: one line per staff and day. Type or pick the **Staff ID** - Staff Name and IC fill in by themselves; the Branch is the staff's outlet (can be changed).
Fill in the **Date** and the correct times (Time In, Lunch In / Out, Dinner In / Out, Time Off Out / In, Time Out), choose a **Reason Code**, type a **Remark** and add **⬆ Evidence** (photo or PDF).
**＋** adds a line. **Save** keeps the form as **Draft**.
Tick **I agree and accept the change of working hours as stated above.** and press **Submit** - status **Submitted**. HR only sees a form once it is submitted.
Until HR opens it you can still **✎ Edit** a Submitted form. When HR opens it, it becomes **Processing** and can no longer be changed.

Who sees what (HR Dept): you see the documents you made, every document with **your own Staff Code** on it, and - if you are a manager with a Coverage Branch - the documents of the staff under you in the structure. Only the maker (or HR) can change a document.

HR opens it (**Processing**) and checks every line. If HR declines a line the form becomes **Incomplete**: press **✎ Edit**, correct the lines marked in orange (HR's remark is under the line) and **Submit** again.
When HR has changed the times in SBClient the form is **Completed**. Open it, check SBClient and for each line press **✔** (acknowledge) or **⊖** (decline - type what is wrong), then **Submit**.
Every line acknowledged = **Acknowledged** (finished). A declined line sends the form back to HR (**Incomplete**).
No answer within **24 hours** after Completed = **Acknowledged** automatically.
**Time Adjustment Listing** shows every submitted form; a red **●** means it waits for you. Opening a Submitted form makes it **Processing**.
For each line press **✔** or **⊖** (a declined line needs a reason). **Return as Incomplete** sends the declined lines back to the outlet.
When every line is ticked, change the times in **SBClient**, then press **✔ Complete** - your User ID becomes the Completed ID.
If the outlet declines after Completed, the form comes back to you: correct SBClient (and the times on the form if needed), tick the lines and **Complete** again.
**⚙ Reason codes** changes the Reason Code list. HR can **Cancel** a form that is not Completed yet.

title: Online Shop Delivery
intro: Warehouse Dept › Online Shop Delivery › New Carrier Manifest / Carrier Manifest List - scan every parcel handed over to a courier and print the hand-over list.

parts.h: Make a carrier manifest and scan
steps: **✚ New Carrier Manifest**: fill in the **Title** (for your reference) and the **Document Title** (shown on the printout) - the Document Title copies the Title until you change it.
Choose the **Date**, the **Channel** (Shopee, Lazada…) and the **Courier Company**. With a courier chosen, a tracking number that does not belong to that courier is refused.
Press **▥ Start Scan**. Scan each parcel's barcode into **Tracking Number** - it is added at once with its number (newest on top) and a short beep.

**📷 Camera** (phones): scan with the phone camera instead of a barcode scanner - hold each barcode in the frame and it is added by itself; keep going parcel after parcel, then **✕ Close**. Works on **https://portal.example.com** only (allow the camera when the phone asks).
A number is refused with a red message and a low double beep when it is already on this manifest, already on another manifest, or not of the chosen courier.
**Typing Off** (default): only the barcode scanner can enter numbers - typing by hand or pasting is refused. Turn **Typing On** to type a number whose barcode cannot be read.
**Delete On** shows ✕ on every number to take it off. Turn it Off again so nothing is removed by mistake.
Finished? Press **🔒 Finish & lock** (Allow Edit off) - no more scanning or taking off. **🔓 Allow Edit** opens it again.
**🖨 Print**: the hand-over list with the total and signature boxes for Company and the courier.
**▦ Carrier Manifest List**: every manifest with its date, courier, channel, number of parcels and status (Scanning / Locked / Cancelled). Click a box at the top to show only that status.
**Find a tracking number**: type all or part of a number and press **Find** - the manifests that have it are shown.

**Courier & Channel Setting** (Settings › Program Settings › Warehouse Dept, or **⚙ Couriers & channels** on the list): add / remove courier companies and channels. For each courier you may give the start of its tracking numbers, e.g. DHL Ecommerce – 7027, 7028; without a start every number is accepted. Press **💾 Save**.
**Cancel** a manifest that was made by mistake - its tracking numbers can then be scanned on another manifest.
**🗑 Delete** (Super Admin only): removes a manifest and its scanned numbers for good - type the manifest number to confirm. Use **Cancel** instead to keep it for record.
Every manifest is also in the Google Sheet tab **Online Shop Delivery** (one row per parcel).

title: BI Dashboard – Collection
intro: Management › BI Dashboard › Collection – today's money collected, updating live (demo: sample data).

steps: The four boxes show **Collected today**, **Receipts today**, **Average receipt** (each with ▲ / ▼ vs yesterday at the same time) and **Month to date** against the target.
**Today by hour** draws the running total through the day; the dashed line is yesterday.
**By payment method** and **By outlet** split today's total; **Latest receipts** lists the newest first and flashes a new one.
Choose an **Outlet** to see only that outlet. **Pause** stops the live updates.
In a real install the figures come from the ERP database through a read-only login and refresh every 30–60 seconds.
**Users**: add accounts, set the account type, reset passwords; the **Signature** column holds each person's signature (draw or upload).
**Access Control**: give rights per person, or use **Positions** (a set of rights for many people). Positions are grouped by Department; changing a position only gives / takes the rights you changed.

**Structure**: open a position and choose **Reports to** (e.g. Cashier reports to Branch Manager). The Positions list then shows the structure as a tree (🌳 Structure); 🏛 By department groups them by department instead. Positions with nobody above and nobody below are listed under "Not in the structure yet".
**Position list** with the **Department** of each position ("+ Add new department..." in the dropdown).
**Department list**, **Outlet list** (Outlet Code, Name, **State**, working hours) and the MC Request lead time.
**⬇ Export all / 📥 Import all** moves all HR Setting to another server in one Excel file.
